rubric_items.reason: Tests cover the API paths for REQ-2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 13. The Completed and No-show tests now isolate the status filter. Gaps: S-2 AC1 (only Cancelled appointments after now) and 20-per-page paging are not exercised directly.

The tests assert observable API bodies (id, starts_at, doctor_name, 400 field keys, ordered ids). Each closed appointment is checked as shown before closing, so the assertions are meaningful. The paging assertion is weak with only 2 patients.

An error path was added (invalid status filter returns 400 with a field error). Edges include null, Cancelled, Completed, No-show, Inactive doctor and past appointments. Missing: the edge where every future appointment is Cancelled.
The tests use Vitest and Supertest in api/test against a throwaway PostgreSQL with a fixed clock, run by npm test. Test names now carry the requirement IDs, as the strategy requires.
No counts or coverage are invented. Coverage is reported as unavailable, which matches the verifier's coverage step (status skip, exit 78).
